lines.ruling: Ruling: model error; on the reply format, not the tax reading. The prompt (.classm/classm.clcw26.3.deepseek.prompt.txt) lists each line as "line N (<type>)". The reply names them the same way, keeping the type ("line 1 (Dollars)"), and the class M parser (tools/transcription/classm.py extract) strips only a leading "line " before matching. So no line of this case was read, while the same model's replies for cases 1, 2 and 4 were read. On this return the worksheet is not reached: Schedule D line 16 is a $51,731 gain (the prompt states "Line 16 is a loss: no"), so clcw26.show is false and the project hides all 13 lines. i1040sd p. 14, Line 21: "You have a capital loss carryover from 2025 to 2026 if you have a loss on line 16 and either ...". The right entry for each line is therefore blank. The reply's value is $29,527.00, the same arithmetic as the project's internal $29,527.00, but entered on a line the source does not reach. By the skipped-line rule that is a defect of the reply, not evidence. No project defect. Dropped: no line of a case whose worksheet is not reached is evidence for the fixture. [dropped]
